children: The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that no actions by it or its staff, labour, agents, supply chain, or any party acting on its behalf, place the Sub-Contractor in breach of the Sub-Contract in any way.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Subcontractor shall be the single point of responsibility for completing the design and/or undertaking of the Sub-Subcontract Works.

children.name: text
children: Where the Subcontract Documents make reference to the Subcontractor in relation to design and/or activities that would include the Sub-Subcontract Works, this shall be deemed included as part of this Subcontractor's Requirements document. The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that all requirements and obligations of the Subcontractor are complied with in respect of the same.

children.name: text
children: {b:Management & Supervision:} The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that there is a competent person in charge of their works at all times during the course of the Sub-Subcontract Works, capable of ensuring good H&S management is taking place in relation to their tasks. This person must also be capable of receiving and communicating site directions on site effectively. The Sub-subcontractor shall ensure that there is representation at weekly internal Black Hat meetings by their supervisor and that management attends fortnightly and also attends the monthly review meetings, including reporting on progress and any major co-ordination matters. The Sub-Subcontractor is encouraged to engage in regular constructive dialogue with the Subcontractor and any important and/or urgent matters shall be raised to the Subcontractor as soon as possible.{br}{br}The supervisor shall ensure that all operatives register and sign in and out of the site on a daily basis (where applicable engaging with M-Site (or similar access software)).{br}{br}The supervisor shall ensure that all operatives receive daily activity briefings and shall provide them with any necessary tool box talks to address specific risks. The supervisor shall ensure that all operatives working on behalf of the Sub-Subcontractor attend a site induction. The supervisor shall ensure that the Sub-Subcontractor maintains suitable records of H&S matters and provide that information to the Subcontractor when reasonably requested for purposes of reporting to the Main Contractor. This should include, but not be limited to, records of RAMS, tool box talks and task-specific briefings (and similar) provided by the Sub-Subcontractor to their workforce.{br}{br}Supervisors shall ensure that their operatives wherever reasonably possible work the maximum hours available to them to complete the works to programme requirements. The Sub-Subcontractor is required to take necessary action to address any concerns raised by the Sub-Subcontractor or principal contractor in regard to operatives' working hours.{br}{br}Supervisors shall ensure that all items provided to the Sub-Subcontractor by the Subcontractor are recorded and signed for. This shall include Supervisors maintaining up to date plant registers.

children.name: text
children: Supervisors shall ensure that only hi-viz vests provided by the Subcontractor are worn on site by the Sub-Subcontractor.

Supervisors shall ensure that arm protection gauntlets are being worn properly and from the wrist up the forearm.{br}{br}Sub-Subcontractors shall ensure that their operatives attend site with the correct PPE at all times and supervisors shall ensure the Sub-Subcontractor holds an appropriate supply of spares on site at all times. Should the Sub-Subcontractor become too reliant on the Sub-Contractor for supply of PPE, the Sub-Contractor reserves the right to charge for reimbursement of the costs of supplying spares.Supervisors shall ensure that Sub-Subcontractor's deliveries are scheduled in accordance with the principal contractor's requirements. Goods should not be delivered too early or inefficiently, and should be distributed and stored with adequate protection taking into account the risk of damage. Pipe and duct racks shall be provided by the Sub-Subcontractor on each floor plate to store goods, along with any other compliant means of storing and distributing materials safely.

Sub-Subcontractor's management and supervision shall ensure that their work areas are kept tidy and free from unnecessary debris/waste that would otherwise cause a hazard. High standards are expected. Waste and excess materials shall be removed from the work area each day by the Sub-subcontractor's labour in accordance with the Sub-Subcontract. Failure to do so, may give rise to alternative labour doing this with the costs incurred in doing so being recovered from the Sub-Subcontractor's account.

Supervisors shall ensure that accurate weekly progress mark-ups are maintained and submitted to the Sub-Contractor each Friday together with records of QA audits, which must be undertaken weekly, or more frequently where appropriate.

The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that open ends to services are bagged off when not being worked on. Air tests shall be carried out at all times and in accordance with the inspection and test plans. Depth gauges shall be used at all times. Wet vacs shall be supplied by the Sub-Subcontractor and located in the vicinity whenever any pressure tests are taking place. Proof of PAT tests shall be provided by the Sub-Subcontractor for their equipment used on site.

children.name: text
children: {b:Compliance with Main Contractor's Requirements:} Specifically, the Sub-Subcontractor shall make himself aware and at all times comply with the main contractor's requirements for H&S procedures and standards including, but not limited to their minimum standards for PPE and training. This includes but is not limited to:

-    ensuring operatives wearing face-fit masks are clean shaven and that the correct masks are being worn for the task being undertaken;{br}{br}-    ensuring that correct PPE is worn in relation to risks of cuts to arms (by using gauntlets) and preventing damage to eyes (by using correct eye protection, including prescription eye protection where applicable).{br}{br}The Sub-Subcontractor has received a copy of the latest Overbury company standards document.

{b:Asbestos & Hazardous Materials:} The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that their workforce undertakes the necessary training and has the necessary awareness of the risks of asbestos and other hazardous materials. This includes what to do if and when it is encountered so that any risk to their health and of others is fully minimised.

children.name: text
children: {b:Testing Pressures:} Where the Sub-Subcontract Works include testing of pipework, please ensure that PRV's are set to 1.5 times the project working pressure, then lower them to working pressure immediately afterwards. Please ensure that the risk assessment and method statement reflect this.

children.name: text
children: {b:Quality Management:} The Sub-Subcontractor shall provide a Quality Inspection & Test Plan prior to starting their works that identifies all hold points relating to the works where checks need to be made to demonstrate compliance. This shall be supported throughout the Sub-Subcontract Works where the Sub-Subcontractor shall undertake those checks together with any necessary remedial action taking place and provide documented evidence where required to support the quality management process.{br}{br}{em:PLEASE NOTE:} The Sub-Contract Sum will be adjusted to allocate a fair and reasonable value to the provision of completed QA checksheets. This sum will be paid when the correctly completed QA checksheets are provided by the Sub-Subcontractor to demonstrate compliance with the specification.

children.name: text
children: {b:Work in Progress:} This shall be adequately protected/sealed by the Sub-Subcontractor from damage by any reasonably foreseeable risks. No open ends are to be left by the Sub-Subcontractor on systems not being worked on and this shall be checked regularly by the Sub-Subcontractor's supervisor.

children.name: text
children: {b:Quality Management in Duct Jointing:} Unless contradictory to manufacturer's recommendations, the preferred method of jointing ducts shall be by using screw and silicone.

children.name: text
children: {b:Quality Management in Insulation:} No Armaflex shall be used for domestic pipework insulation.

children.name: text
children: {b:Compliance with Manufacturer's Recommendations:} All manufacturer's recommendations are to be fully complied with to ensure quality installation and that no guarantees are invalidated. Any guarantees associated with products/systems are to be provided by the Sub-Subcontractor to their maximum available period.

children.name: text
children: {b:Covid-19:} The Sub-Subcontractor shall comply with all statutory requirements and follow industry guidance (for example, the Construction Leadership Council) in relation to working practices under the effects of Covid-19. Protection of the workforce, other contractors, clients etc. and the public at large shall be of paramount importance.

children: {b:Generally:}{br}{br}The Sub-Subcontract Works must comply with Statutory Requirements, including but not limited to, compliance with Building Regulations and Planning consent.{br}{br}The Sub-Subcontractor confirms that he has access to all necessary drawings, specifications and technical documents necessary to undertake the Sub-Subcontract Works.{br}{br}The Sub-Subcontractor must comply with the specification contained within the Contractor's Requirements (&/or Employer's Requirements) together with all associated drawings and technical documents. The Sub-Subcontractor must not do anything to place the Subcontractor in breach of the Subcontract.

For services, this includes floor & site plans, layout of systems, schematics, cross sections and elevations, plantroom layouts, principal service installation areas, specific installation details for equipment, and equipment schedules.

More generally, this includes the type, quality, size & thickness of materials, method of fixing, locations, measurement requirements for services elements, site access, location to and from the works locations, type & nature of construction of the building.

The Sub-Subcontractor shall be responsible for the selection of goods and fixings suitable for the successful undertaking of the Sub-Subcontract works. This shall take due regard for the structural, thermal, acoustic and fire performance requirements of the specification. Any installations to be exposed in the finished state shall be appropriately installed with due regard for aesthetics to the reasonable satisfaction of the Employer, including the provision of any seals, tapes, trims, caps, etc that may be necessary to do so. Any requirements of the specification for anti-vibration measures etc shall be deemed included.

Workmanship shall be in accordance with all good practice, industry standards and manufacturer’s recommendations and shall achieve the specification. Due regard shall be taken of spatial requirements and ease of access for future maintenance. All Sub-Subcontract Works will be handed over to the Subcontractor in a new, clean condition. Any damage occurring during supply, distribution and installation shall be made good at the Sub-Subcontractor’s cost. No costs shall be accepted by the Subcontractor for repairs arising due to damage that could have been prevented by adequate protection.

The Sub-Subcontractor must undertake all installation in a fashion that will protect any associated manufacturer’s guarantees. The Sub-Subcontractor shall procure and pass on the benefit of any product guarantees to the Subcontractor and include all associated paperwork within the O&M information.

The Sub-Subcontractor shall be aware of all movement joints and fire compartmentation lines and take necessary action to ensure that the Sub-Subcontract Works do not compromise the performance of these elements.

All cutting, jointing, welding is deemed included. Any extra material for fittings, bends, etc. is deemed included, as is all waste from cuts etc. All fittings, flanges, bends, tees, junctions, reducers, valves, bosses, sockets, etc. are all deemed included.

The method of fixing & spacing of joints, type of brackets & supports and the finish shall be at the discretion of the Sub-Subcontractor, subject to the Subcontractor’s approval where reasonable and appropriate, and unless where otherwise described by the specification &/or the manufacturer’s requirements.

children: The Sub-Subcontractor shall be responsible for the facilities and attendances described in the schedule of attendances / inclusions copied below. Following feedback received, observations made and lessons learnt from earlier works, it is an express commitment by the Sub-Subcontractor to fully engage with and co-operate with the following:

children.name: text
children: Supervision & Management: The Sub-Subcontractor shall provide adequate and competent full-time site based supervision at all times in accordance with this Sub-Subcontract. In addition to other relevant documentation, the Sub-Subcontractor's supervision shall ensure that their team operate in full compliance with the Main Contractor's information and guidance, a copy of which has been provided to the Sub-Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: Workforce Engagement: The Sub-Subcontractor's management and supervision shall ensure that all team members have prepared for and undertaken the necessary pre-start inductions and that all necessary information is passed to the workforce via appropriate engagement sessions such as daily activity briefings, tool box talks, etc. Records shall be kept by the Sub-Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: Deliveries, Access & Distribution: The Main Contractor's tower crane and/or goods hoist shall be available for use by the Sub-Subcontractor, subject to its availability. The Sub-Contractor cannot guarantee its performance and takes no liability for its availability and/or suitability. Horizontal distribution responsibility shall be by the Sub-Subcontractor.{br}{br}Access equipment up to 4.5m is included by the Sub-Subcontractor.{br}{br}Offloading & horizontal distribution shall be by the Sub-Subcontractor.

children.name: text
children: H&S and PPE: The Sub-Subcontractor's management and supervision shall ensure full compliance by the Sub-Subcontractor's workforce and supply chain with the H&S and PPE requirements of the project, set out in this Sub-Subcontract and the Main Contractor's information (a copy of which has been provided to the Sub-Subcontractor).{br}{br}The Subcontractor shall provide the Sub-Subcontractor's operatives with one Hi-Viz vest for the project. All other PPE shall be provided by the Sub-Subcontractor as noted below.

children.name: text
children: Quality control and defect avoidance: The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that they undertake a benchmark installation and engage with the Sub-Contractor to provide this. The Sub-Subcontractor shall ensure that all works conform to the specification, meet manufacturer's recommendations and match the quality provided by the benchmark installation. Good and proper QA records shall be kept by the Sub-Subcontractor.{br}{br}A benchmark area shall be identified to set the standards required and then to be matched and continued throughout the project. The parties shall review a selected FCU installed and connected, de-snag and then sign off as an agreed standard. QA sheets then required ongoing to provide evidence and allow progressive snagging.{br}{br}The Sub-Contractor will encourage good health and safety attitude and best practice by recognising good examples shown by the workforce. This will be via a donation to a charity nominated by the operative who has shown and demonstrated the best attitude and output in relation to H&S and/or Quality Management.
